accessNotes: The legacy spectrum.adobe.com/page/data-visualization-fundamentals/ and /page/color-for-data-visualization/ pages now redirect/serve the new 'Spectrum Hub' home page with no data-viz content, and the Wayback Machine returned 503 (temporarily offline). All concrete values were therefore taken from Adobe's official open-source implementation, React Spectrum Charts (github.com/adobe/react-spectrum-charts, Vega-based), whose Spectrum 2 Vega config, colour tokens and constants encode the Spectrum data-viz guidance; plus its documentation screenshots. Prose guidance (e.g. do/don't rules on pies, ordering) could not be read first-hand.
summary: Spectrum is Adobe's product design system; its charts are clean, airy product-UI visualisations set in Adobe Clean on a transparent/light-grey surface. Characteristic traits are a 16-colour categorical palette that opens with seafoam, indigo, orange and magenta, no axis domain lines or ticks (just light grey gridlines and a dark baseline rule), rounded-square legend swatches centred below the chart, rounded bar ends and thick 2.5px lines. Light and dark themes are first-class.

colors.categoricalNotes: Tokens categorical-100…categorical-1600 used strictly in this order. Count-specific palettes are prefixes: categorical6 (first 6), categorical12 (first 12), categorical16 (all). Spectrum 2 adds categorical-1700…2000 for a 20-colour set (categorical-1700 = #12B0DA). Default single-series colour is categorical-100 (#0FB5AE seafoam).
colors.notes: Default sequential ramp is Viridis (sequentialViridis9 shown, light→dark yellow→purple); other sequential ramps: magma, rose, cerulean (#EAFFF1→#180055), forest. Diverging schemes: red-blue (shown, 9-step), red-yellow-blue, orange-yellow-seafoam (#580000 … #FFFFE0 … #002C2D; the default Vega 'diverging' range). Text = gray-800 (#222222 light / #EBEBEB dark); axis labels and titles = gray-700 (#464646 light / #D0D0D0 dark); gridlines = gray-300 (#D5D5D5 light / #4B4B4B dark); baseline/rule = gray-800. Dark mode swaps the gray ramp (gray-50 = #000000, gray-100 = #1D1D1D) but keeps the same categorical hues. Hover/selection uses blue-400 strokes. Non-hovered series fade to opacity factor 0.2 (FADE_FACTOR).

typography.fallback: adobe-clean, 'Source Sans Pro', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Ubuntu, 'Trebuchet MS', 'Lucida Grande', sans-serif

axisTitle.placement: rotated, centred on the y axis; centred below the x axis with 16px padding

typography.notes: One uniform font size, 14px, for axis labels, axis titles, legend labels/titles and text marks; chart title 22px anchored start (left) to the plot group. Responsive chart-size tiers scale fonts/strokes by 0.75 (S, <400px), 1 (M), 1.25 (L, ≥800px). Large numbers abbreviated with K (e.g. '4K', '40K').

structure.gridlines: Value-axis gridlines only (horizontal for column/line charts, vertical for horizontal bars), solid 1px gray-300 #D5D5D5.
structure.axisLine: Axis domain lines off (domain: false); a solid dark gray-800 1px baseline rule is drawn at zero / the category axis (see screenshots).
structure.ticks: Tick marks off by default (ticks: false); when enabled 8px, gray-300, round cap.
structure.zeroLine: Yes — zero baseline drawn as a dark 1px rule (#222222) over the light grid.
structure.unitPlacement: Abbreviated in tick labels (K/M); time axes show day on first row and month as a second label line under the first tick (e.g. '8' / 'Nov').
structure.frame: none (transparent background; meant to sit inside a Spectrum card/view)
structure.background: transparent (screenshots on white or very light grey #F8F8F8)
structure.notes: Axis label padding 8px; band axes centre labels on bands (bandPosition 0.5); labelOverlap true.

legend.placement: bottom (horizontal, centred, 24px offset); left/right legends vertical
legend.directLabels: Supported: line end labels in the series colour, bold, right-aligned at line end; donut segment labels outside the ring with bold category + percentage and value.
legend.title: Shown above legend entries in bold when supplied (e.g. 'Operating system').
legend.notes: Legend entries spaced 20px column padding, 8px row padding, label limit 184px. Legends are interactive: hover highlights a series (others fade), click toggles visibility; legend tooltips after 350ms.

marks.bars: Rounded ends: corner radius 6px on the outer end of the bar/stack only; band padding ratio 0.4; no outline (strokeWidth 0); stacked segments separated by thin white gaps.
marks.lines: strokeWidth 2.5 (theme) / 2px base scaled by size tier; hover stroke +0.5; no points by default; linear interpolation; line types cycle solid, dashed, dotted, dotDash, longDash, twoDash for secondary encodings.
marks.points: Default symbol size 100 (≈8px diameter), stroke width 2, rounded-square default shape.
marks.pies: Donut is the provided form (react-spectrum-charts 'Donut'): thin ring, white separators between segments, optional large centred summary metric with a label beneath (hidden if inner radius < 45px), segment labels outside; semicircle variant available.

labels.dataLabels: Optional direct labels: bar value labels at the bar end, line end labels in series colour, donut segment labels outside ring (bold name, then '26%  10K').
labels.numberFormat: Compact abbreviations K/M (e.g. 4K, 8.3K, 40K); percentages without decimals in donut labels; locale default en-US.
labels.dates: Multi-line time axis: day number per tick, month name under the first tick of each month (e.g. '8' then 'Nov').

furniture.title: Optional 22px title anchored left to the plot group, 10px offset.
furniture.other: Charts are embedded in product UI, so no chart numbering or source lines; reference lines and annotations supported.

annotations: Reference lines drawn as gray-800 1px rules with labels; bar annotations print text at bar ends; metric-range bands shown as translucent areas around a trend line.
layout: autosize 'fit' to container, resize true. Chart size tiers by width: S < 400px, M 400–800px, L ≥ 800px with scale ratios 0.75 / 1 / 1.25 for strokes, fonts, point sizes and label gaps (base label gap 12px).
interaction: Rich product interactivity: hover highlights the hovered series/item and fades others to 20% (FADE_FACTOR 0.2); hover stroke width +0.5px; selection ring (blue-400) on donuts and bars; tooltips and popovers on marks; legend hover-highlight and click-to-hide.
accessibility: Palettes designed to contrast on both light and dark themes; full dark mode via gray-ramp inversion; line dash patterns and symbol shapes available as secondary encodings so colour is not the only cue.

chartTypes.notes: Chart set taken from React Spectrum Charts components; first-hand Spectrum prose on discouraged types was not reachable.

distinctiveRules.rule: Categorical colours are applied in fixed token order starting seafoam #0FB5AE, indigo #4046CA, orange #F68511, magenta #DE3D82, periwinkle #7E84FA, green #72E06A.
distinctiveRules.quote: categorical6 = [categorical-100 … categorical-600]; categorical12/16 extend the same list

distinctiveRules.rule: No axis domain lines and no tick marks; only light grey #D5D5D5 gridlines plus a dark #222222 zero/baseline rule.
distinctiveRules.quote: domain: false … gridColor: gray300 … ticks: false … rule: { stroke: gray800, strokeWidth: 1 }

distinctiveRules.rule: Single uniform 14px font size in Adobe Clean for all axis labels, axis titles, legend text and data text; axis text in gray-700 #464646, non-bold.
Chart title 22px, left-anchored to the plot group.
Legend below the chart, horizontal and centred, with rounded-square swatches (~16px) and optional bold legend title above the entries.
distinctiveRules.quote: horizontalLegendLayout { direction: 'horizontal', center: true, offset: 24 }; symbolType: ROUNDED_SQUARE_PATH; symbolSize 250

distinctiveRules.rule: Bars have 6px rounded corners on the value end only, band padding 0.4, no outline; stacked segments separated by thin white gaps.
Lines are thick (2.5px) with no point markers; areas filled at 0.8 opacity.
Default sequential ramp is Viridis (yellow #FDE725 → purple #440154); default diverging is orange-yellow-seafoam.
Hovering a series or legend entry fades all other marks to 20% opacity.
Donuts are thin rings with white segment separators and a large centred summary metric (e.g. '40K' over 'Visitors'); segment labels outside the ring with bold category name and 'pct  value' beneath.
Responsive size tiers: below 400px width strokes/fonts/points scale ×0.75, above 800px ×1.25.
distinctiveRules.quote: CHART_SIZE_BREAKPOINTS = { M: 400, L: 800 }; CHART_SIZE_SCALE_RATIOS = { S: 0.75, M: 1, L: 1.25 }

distinctiveRules.rule: Dark mode inverts the gray ramp (text #EBEBEB, axis labels #D0D0D0, gridlines #4B4B4B) while keeping the same categorical hues; chart background is transparent.
Line series can be direct-labelled at the right end in the series colour, bold, in addition to the bottom legend.
distinctiveRules.quote: screenshot: 'Add Freeform table' label in magenta at line end

referenceImages.describes: Horizontal stacked bar chart on white, no title. Three thick bars (Chrome, Firefox, Safari) with category labels left in dark grey Adobe Clean ~14px; bold rotated y-axis title 'Browser'. Stacks: orange #F68511 'Other', indigo #4046CA 'Mac', seafoam #0FB5AE 'Windows', separated by thin white gaps, with rounded corners only on the right end of each stack. Thin light-grey vertical gridlines at each integer 0–10; a solid black vertical baseline at 0; no other axis lines or ticks. Bold x-axis title 'Downloads' centred below. Legend at bottom centre with bold title 'Operating system' and rounded-square swatches. No source line or logo.

Spectrum 2 multi-line chart on very light grey (#F8F8F8) background. Four ~2.5px straight-segment lines (indigo-violet, magenta-red, orange, light blue — S2 categorical hues) with no point markers. Direct labels in bold, coloured to match each series, right-aligned at line ends ('Add Freeform table', 'Add Bar viz'…). Light grey horizontal gridlines at 2K/4K, dark baseline at 0; y tick labels '0, 2K, 4K' on the left; rotated y-axis title 'Users' in regular weight. x axis shows day numbers 8–14 with 'Nov' on a second line under the first tick, small tick marks. Legend centred below with rounded-square swatches, wrapping to two rows. No title, source or logo.

Thin donut ring on white, segments in palette order clockwise from 12 o'clock: seafoam Chrome, indigo Firefox, orange Safari, magenta Opera, periwinkle Other, green Brave, blue small slice; white separators between segments. Large centred summary '40K' (~40px, regular) with 'Visitors' beneath. Outside labels: bold category name, then '26%  10K' in regular weight, positioned next to each segment. No legend, no title.
